GRID_AUTHORITY_WARNING: AutoSprite grids are NOT the repo-standard 4x2. Slice each sheet by its OWN (cols, rows): walk = 4 cols x 4 rows (16 frames), all others = 3 cols x 3 rows (8 frames, cell 8 EMPTY). Read frames 0..frameCount-1 row-major; ignore trailing empty cell(s). See [[feedback_godot_atlas_grid_authority]].

sheets.note: FRONT-FACING walk (faces player). Single sheet used for BOTH move directions — no walk_left/walk_right pair needed (front-facing has no directional lean). 포승줄 visible coiled at front waist. v1 'walk' (sidescroller) was REJECTED for going side-profile; this iso_walk_down is the canonical anchor.
Front-facing breathing bob. Wall-clock loop (skill §17.5 idle pattern).
Front-facing fast run = dash. External-timer driven (boss_dash_timer).
Triumphant jump. Plays once, hold on last frame. (Slightly understated — candidate for a punchier v2 if desired.)

포승줄 (arrest_rope) cast — brown rope whips out in an arc from the hand. Pair the release frame with the arrest_rope skill on-boss-hit activation (anticipatory, skill §8.4.1). Doubles as the boss strike pose.
Front-facing slump. Plays once, hold on last frame; trigger_defeat clears is_victorious (skill §17.6).

priority_chain: defeat > victory > stun > dash > attack(arrest_rope active) > walk > idle (skill §17.6)

pojol_summon.identity: low-rank constable: black wide-brim hat, plain navy uniform (NO gold badge), brown belt, short brown wooden club, young beardless face. Clearly subordinate to the chief.
pojol_summon.render_note: Summoned by the patrol_guards skill — 2 guards spawned below the boss, patrolling laterally (original 300f / ~110-180 px/sec). Renders MUCH smaller than the boss (original 32x44 vs boss 96x192). Front-facing walk used regardless of patrol direction.
